title: Microsoft signs multibillion-dollar AI infrastructure deal with Lambda

sources.quote: SAN FRANCISCO, CA, November 3, 2025 — Lambda, the Superintelligence Cloud, today announced a multibillion-dollar agreement with Microsoft to deploy AI infrastructure powered by tens of thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, including NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems.

explain: Microsoft agreed to rent AI computing built on tens of thousands of Nvidia GPUs from Lambda. The companies called it multibillion-dollar but did not give an exact figure.
